name: Linkwave LW350-T2 Dual-Port 1GbE
analog: Intel Ethernet Server Adapter I350-T2 (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Two gigabit RJ45 ports for any server with a spare x4 slot.
doc_notes: Install in any PCIe x4, x8 or x16 slot; the card runs at PCIe 2.1 x4.
Swap to the low-profile bracket for 2U servers: remove the two small screws, fit the short bracket, refit the screws.
Port 1 is next to the board edge marked P1; the green LED shows link, the amber LED blinks with traffic.
Supports 10/100/1000BASE-T over Cat5e or better, up to 100 m.
Wake-on-LAN and VLAN tagging are set in the driver's advanced properties.
Hold the card by its edges and bracket; do not touch the gold contacts.
Limited lifetime warranty when registered within 90 days.

name: Linkwave LW710-DA2 Dual-Port 10GbE SFP+
analog: Intel Ethernet Converged Network Adapter X710-DA2 (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Two SFP+ cages for 10 Gb fibre or DAC links.
doc_notes: Install in a PCIe x8 or x16 slot (PCIe 3.0 x8 for full 2 x 10 Gb/s).
Use 10GBASE-SR/LR SFP+ optics or SFP+ direct-attach copper cables up to 7 m.
Keep the dust plugs in unused cages; push a module in until it clicks, pull the bail to remove it.
Link LED green = 10 Gb/s, amber = 1 Gb/s; the activity LED blinks with traffic.
Needs 200 LFM of airflow over the heatsink; do not use in a fanless case.
A low-profile bracket is in the box.
Limited lifetime warranty.

name: Melnet Strand-6 Lx Dual-Port 25GbE SFP28
analog: NVIDIA Mellanox ConnectX-6 Lx MCX631102AN-ADAT (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Two 25 Gb SFP28 ports with RDMA offloads.
doc_notes: Install in a PCIe 4.0 x8 slot (works in PCIe 3.0 at reduced throughput).
Each SFP28 cage takes 25G, 10G or 1G modules and DAC cables.
RoCE v2 and SR-IOV are enabled with the Melnet firmware tool after the driver install.
Port LEDs: green link, amber activity; both blinking = beacon (identify) mode.
Requires server airflow of 300 LFM; the controller throttles above 105 °C.
Keep the dust plugs in unused cages.
Three-year limited warranty.

name: Melnet Strand-6 Dx Dual-Port 100GbE QSFP28
analog: NVIDIA Mellanox ConnectX-6 Dx MCX623106AN-CDAT (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Two 100 Gb QSFP28 ports for the spine and the GPU servers.
doc_notes: Install in a PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for full 2 x 100 Gb/s; an x8 slot halves the bandwidth.
Each QSFP28 cage takes 100G optics, DAC, or a breakout cable to 4 x 25G.
Use passive DAC up to 3 m, active optical cables beyond that.
Typical power 24 W, more with active optics: needs strong front-to-back server airflow.
Port LEDs: green link, amber activity.
Keep the dust plugs in unused cages; never look into an open optical port.
Three-year limited warranty.

name: Broadline 9500-16i Tri-Mode HBA
analog: Broadcom HBA 9500-16i (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Connects 16 SAS, SATA or NVMe drives to a server's backplane.
doc_notes: Install in a PCIe 4.0 x8 slot.
Connector C0 serves drives 0-7, connector C1 drives 8-15 (SFF-8654 x8 SlimSAS).
Tri-mode: SAS-3 12 Gb/s, SATA 6 Gb/s and NVMe drives through a tri-mode backplane.
Use SFF-8654 to 4 x SFF-8482 or to the backplane's own connectors; cables are sold separately.
Drives are passed through to the OS (IT mode): no RAID on this card.
Needs 200 LFM of airflow over the heatsink.
Three-year limited warranty.

name: Broadline 9560-16i RAID Controller 8 GB
analog: Broadcom MegaRAID 9560-16i with a CacheVault CVPM05 module (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Hardware RAID for 16 drives, 8 GB cache kept safe by a supercap.
doc_notes: Install in a PCIe 4.0 x8 slot.
Mount the CacheGuard supercap pack on the chassis clip and plug its cable into the card's 6-pin header before power-on.
The 8 GB cache is protected by the supercap: on power loss it is copied to flash.
RAID levels 0, 1, 5, 6, 10, 50 and 60; up to 240 drives with expanders.
Connector C0 serves drives 0-7, C1 drives 8-15 (SFF-8654 x8).
Create arrays in the card's BIOS utility (Ctrl+R at boot) or with the Broadline command-line tool.
Three-year limited warranty, the supercap one year.

name: Strata SG840 4U 8-GPU Server
analog: Supermicro SYS-421GE / Gigabyte G493 class 8-GPU 4U barebone (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Eight double-width GPU sleds, four 3 kW PSUs, ten hot-swap fans.
doc_notes: Two people or a lift: the server weighs 48 kg without GPUs.
Fit the slide rails at the rack's front and rear rails first; the rails click at both ends.
Slide each GPU sled out by its handle after pressing the green release; one double-width GPU per sled.
Connect all four power supplies (3+1 redundant, 200-240 V); 3 kW per supply.
The front ear LEDs: health green, fault amber; the blue ID LED is toggled by the i button.
Ten hot-swap fans: replace a failed fan within 60 s.
BMC: connect the IPMI port; default user is on the service tag.
Three-year next-business-day warranty.

name: Strata SR224 2U 24-Bay Storage Server
analog: Dell PowerEdge R740xd 24 x 2.5" class storage server (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Twenty-four hot-swap 2.5" bays in two rack units.
doc_notes: Fit the slide rails, then slide the server in until the ears meet the rack; tighten the two thumbscrews.
Bays 0-23 are numbered from the left; press the green release and swing the lever to remove a tray.
Drive LEDs: green activity, amber fault or locate.
Connect both power supplies to separate circuits (1+1 redundant).
Populate DIMMs A1 and B1 first, then A2 and B2.
Do not run without the air shroud or with empty bays without blanks.
Three-year next-business-day warranty.

name: Linkwave LS-4804X 48-Port Gigabit Switch
analog: Cisco CBS350-48T-4X (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: 48 gigabit ports and four 10 Gb SFP+ uplinks, managed.
doc_notes: Mount with the four rack screws through the ears; leave 50 mm behind the rear for airflow.
Default management address 192.168.1.254, user admin; change the password at first login.
Ports 1-48: 10/100/1000BASE-T; ports 49-52: 10G SFP+ uplinks (dust plugs fitted).
Console: RJ45 on the rear, 115200 8-N-1.
Hold RESET 10 s to restore the factory settings.
PWR green = on, SYS blinking = booting, FAN amber = fan fault.
Limited lifetime warranty.

name: Linkwave LS-1600X 16-Port 10G SFP+ Aggregation Switch
analog: MikroTik CRS317-1G-16S+RM / Ubiquiti aggregation class (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Sixteen 10 Gb SFP+ ports to tie the access switches together.
doc_notes: Mount with the four rack screws through the ears.
Ports 1-16 are 10G SFP+; they also take 1G SFP modules.
Connect both power inputs for redundancy; PS1 and PS2 LEDs show each supply.
Out-of-band management on the MGMT port, console on the RJ45 CONSOLE port at 115200.
Keep the dust plugs in unused cages.
Five-year limited warranty.

name: Strata 1U Cantilever Shelf
analog: StarTech CABSHELF 1U vented cantilever shelf (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: A front-mounted vented shelf for gear without rack ears.
doc_notes: Front mount only: four M6 screws and cage nuts through the ears.
Maximum load 25 kg, spread evenly across the tray.
Leave the U above the shelf free for the equipment on it.
The vent slots keep air moving; don't cover them completely.
Five-year warranty.

name: Strata 1U Blanking Panel
analog: APC AR8136BLK 1U blanking panel (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Closes an empty U so the hot air stays behind the rack.
doc_notes: Fill every empty U on the front of the rack: hot air must not flow back to the intake.
Fits any EIA-310 19" rack; two M6 screws with cage nuts per side, both included.
The flanges point into the rack.
Tool-less version available as STRATA BP-1T.
Five-year warranty against rust and paint defects.

name: Strata 2U Blanking Panel
analog: APC AR8126A 2U blanking panel (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Closes two empty U so the hot air stays behind the rack.
doc_notes: Fill every empty U on the front of the rack: hot air must not flow back to the intake.
Fits any EIA-310 19" rack; two M6 screws with cage nuts per side, both included.
The flanges point into the rack.
Covers two rack units.
Five-year warranty against rust and paint defects.

name: Strata Cable Management Arm 1U
analog: Dell PowerEdge cable management arm (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: Keeps a 1U server's cables tidy when it slides out on its rails.

specs.fits: 1U servers on the STRATA slide rails (server_1u)

doc_notes: For STRATA 1U servers on the STRATA sliding rails.
Clip the outer connector into the right-hand outer rail and the support bracket into the left rail.
Clip the inner connector onto the server's inner rail until the green tab clicks.
Route the cables through the hoops and close the straps; leave slack at the elbow.
Check the server slides fully out and back without pulling a cable.
Three-year warranty.

name: Strata KMM 18.5" 1U Console Drawer
analog: Dell DKMMLED185 / Tripp Lite B021 class 1U LCD KVM drawer (docs only, never shown in game)
desc: A fold-out screen, keyboard and touchpad in one rack unit.
doc_notes: Fit the rails at the front and rear rack rails; the drawer locks closed.
Pull both green tabs and slide the drawer out, then lift the screen.
Connect the VGA and USB-B cable to the server or a KVM switch; power through the rear C14 inlet.
18.5" LCD, 1366 x 768; the LCD button turns the backlight off.
Close the screen before pushing the drawer in.
Three-year warranty.
